decisions.reason: Building data digital twin service is strategically relevant and growing, so we keep it under monitoring.
Authentication and identity delegation service overlaps with Product E and has low visibility, so we drop it to focus resources on the GIS-specific identity service.
Open GIS application development framework is a strategic product line supporting our open component ecosystem, so we keep it.
Identity and access service for GIS applications is close to our core and actively promoted, so we keep it.
Geodata business process consulting workshop fits our consulting and training strengths and was newly launched, so we keep it.
